Label: Study Identifier
Derivation: Copy DM.STUDYID.

Label: Unique Subject Identifier
Derivation: Copy DM.USUBJID. One row per DM.USUBJID.

Label: Subject Identifier for the Study
Derivation: Copy DM.SUBJID.

Label: Study Site Identifier
Derivation: Copy DM.SITEID.

Label: Age
Derivation: Copy DM.AGE. DM.AGEU is years for every subject.

Label: Age Units
Derivation: Copy DM.AGEU.

Label: Pooled Age Group 1
Derivation: Set AGEGR1 from ADSL.AGE. Use <65 when ADSL.AGE is below 65. Use 65-80 when ADSL.AGE is from 65 through 80 inclusive. Use >80 when ADSL.AGE is above 80.

Label: Pooled Age Group 1 (N)
Derivation: Set AGEGR1N from ADSL.AGEGR1. The group <65 has code 1, the group 65-80 has code 2, and the group >80 has code 3.

Label: Sex
Derivation: Copy DM.SEX.

Label: Race
Derivation: Copy DM.RACE.

Label: Race (N)
Derivation: Set RACEN from ADSL.RACE. WHITE has code 1. BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN has code 2. ASIAN has code 3. AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE has code 4. Leave RACEN missing for any other value.

Label: Ethnicity
Derivation: Copy DM.ETHNIC.

Label: Country
Derivation: Copy DM.COUNTRY.

Label: Description of Planned Arm
Derivation: Copy DM.ARM.

Label: Description of Actual Arm
Derivation: Copy DM.ACTARM.

Label: Planned Treatment for Period 01
Derivation: Copy DM.ARM. Screen Failure is retained as its own planned value.

Label: Planned Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Set TRT01PN from ADSL.TRT01P. Placebo has code 0. Xanomeline Low Dose has code 1. Xanomeline High Dose has code 2. Screen Failure has code 3. Leave TRT01PN missing for any other value.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
Derivation: Copy DM.ACTARM. This differs from ADSL.TRT01P when the subject was treated with a different regimen from the planned regimen.

Label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
Derivation: Set TRT01AN from ADSL.TRT01A using the same codes as ADSL.TRT01PN. Placebo has code 0. Xanomeline Low Dose has code 1. Xanomeline High Dose has code 2. Screen Failure has code 3.

Label: Datetime of First Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Keep EX rows for the subject where EX.EXDOSE is greater than zero or EX.EXTRT equals PLACEBO, and EX.EXSTDTC is a complete calendar day. A complete calendar day is four digits, a hyphen, two digits, a hyphen, and two digits, with nothing after the day. Sort qualifying rows by EX.EXSTDTC ascending and then by EX.EXSEQ ascending. The first row supplies the calendar day. EX.EXSTDTC contains no clock time, so set the hour, minute, and second to 00:00:00. Leave TRTSDTM missing when the subject has no qualifying row.

Label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Set TRTSDT to the calendar day of ADSL.TRTSDTM. Leave TRTSDT missing when ADSL.TRTSDTM is missing.

Label: Date Imputation Flag for TRTSDT
Derivation: Leave TRTSDTF blank. A qualifying EX.EXSTDTC is a complete calendar day, so the day, month, and year on ADSL.TRTSDTM are not imputed. The flag would be D when only the day is imputed, M when the month is imputed, and Y when the year is imputed.

Label: Time Imputation Flag for TRTSDTM
Derivation: Set TRTSTMF to H when ADSL.TRTSDTM is not missing, because the clock time was imputed to 00:00:00. Leave TRTSTMF blank when ADSL.TRTSDTM is missing. H means the hour and the smaller time parts were imputed together.

Label: Datetime of Last Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Keep EX rows for the subject where EX.EXDOSE is greater than zero or EX.EXTRT equals PLACEBO. For each such row the candidate calendar day is EX.EXENDTC when EX.EXENDTC is a complete calendar day. When EX.EXENDTC is blank, the candidate is EX.EXSTDTC when EX.EXSTDTC is a complete calendar day. Ignore a row with no candidate. Choose the latest candidate day and break a tie with the greatest EX.EXSEQ. The source has no clock time, so set the hour, minute, and second to 23:59:59. Leave TRTEDTM missing when the subject has no candidate day.

Label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Derivation: Set TRTEDT to the calendar day of ADSL.TRTEDTM. Leave TRTEDT missing when ADSL.TRTEDTM is missing.

Label: Date Imputation Flag for TRTEDT
Derivation: Leave TRTEDTF blank. The candidate day taken from EX.EXENDTC or EX.EXSTDTC is a complete calendar day, so the day, month, and year on ADSL.TRTEDTM are not imputed. The flag would be D when only the day is imputed, M when the month is imputed, and Y when the year is imputed.

Label: Time Imputation Flag for TRTEDTM
Derivation: Set TRTETMF to H when ADSL.TRTEDTM is not missing, because the clock time was imputed to 23:59:59. Leave TRTETMF blank when ADSL.TRTEDTM is missing.

Label: Total Treatment Duration (Days)
Derivation: When ADSL.TRTSDT and ADSL.TRTEDT are both non-missing, set TRTDURD to the number of calendar days from ADSL.TRTSDT through ADSL.TRTEDT, which is ADSL.TRTEDT minus ADSL.TRTSDT plus 1. Otherwise leave TRTDURD missing.

Label: Date of Randomization
Derivation: Use DS rows where DS.DSCAT equals PROTOCOL MILESTONE and DS.DSDECOD equals RANDOMIZED. If more than one row matches the subject, keep the earliest DS.DSSTDTC and then the smallest DS.DSSEQ. Set RANDDT to DS.DSSTDTC when that value is a complete calendar day. Leave RANDDT missing when the subject has no such row.

Label: Safety Population Flag
Derivation: Set SAFFL to Y when the subject has at least one EX row where EX.EXDOSE is greater than zero or EX.EXTRT equals PLACEBO. Otherwise set SAFFL to N.

Label: Intent-to-Treat Population Flag
Derivation: Set ITTFL to Y when a SUPPDM row for SUPPDM.USUBJID has SUPPDM.QNAM equal to ITT and SUPPDM.QVAL equal to Y. Otherwise set ITTFL to N.

Label: Efficacy Population Flag
Derivation: Set EFFFL to Y when a SUPPDM row for SUPPDM.USUBJID has SUPPDM.QNAM equal to EFFICACY and SUPPDM.QVAL equal to Y. Otherwise set EFFFL to N.

Label: Completers of Week 8 Population Flag
Derivation: Set COMP8FL to Y when a SUPPDM row for SUPPDM.USUBJID has SUPPDM.QNAM equal to COMPLT8 and SUPPDM.QVAL equal to Y. Otherwise set COMP8FL to N.

Label: Completers of Week 16 Population Flag
Derivation: Set COMP16FL to Y when a SUPPDM row for SUPPDM.USUBJID has SUPPDM.QNAM equal to COMPLT16 and SUPPDM.QVAL equal to Y. Otherwise set COMP16FL to N.

Label: Completers of Week 24 Population Flag
Derivation: Set COMP24FL to Y when a SUPPDM row for SUPPDM.USUBJID has SUPPDM.QNAM equal to COMPLT24 and SUPPDM.QVAL equal to Y. Otherwise set COMP24FL to N.

Label: Subject Death Flag
Derivation: Set DTHFL to Y when DM.DTHFL equals Y. Otherwise set DTHFL to N.

Label: Date of Death
Derivation: Set DTHDT to DM.DTHDTC when DM.DTHDTC is a complete calendar day. Otherwise leave DTHDT missing.

Label: End of Study Status
Derivation: Use the DS row where DS.DSCAT equals DISPOSITION EVENT. If more than one row matches the subject, keep the earliest DS.DSSTDTC and then the smallest DS.DSSEQ. Set EOSSTT to COMPLETED when DS.DSDECOD equals COMPLETED. Otherwise set EOSSTT to DISCONTINUED. Leave EOSSTT missing when the subject has no disposition row.

Label: Reason for Discontinuation from Study
Derivation: Use the same DS row as ADSL.EOSSTT, where DS.DSCAT equals DISPOSITION EVENT, choosing the earliest DS.DSSTDTC and then the smallest DS.DSSEQ when more than one row matches. When ADSL.EOSSTT equals DISCONTINUED, set DCSREAS to DS.DSDECOD. Otherwise leave DCSREAS blank.

Label: Subject Reference End Date
Derivation: Set RFENDT to DM.RFENDTC when DM.RFENDTC is a complete calendar day. Otherwise leave RFENDT missing.

Label: Date Last Known Alive
Source: DM.RFPENDTC; DM.RFENDTC; DM.DTHDTC; DS.DSSTDTC; EX.EXSTDTC; EX.EXENDTC; AE.AESTDTC; AE.AEENDTC; VS.VSDTC; LB.LBDTC; SV.SVSTDTC; SV.SVENDTC; CM.CMSTDTC; CM.CMENDTC; MH.MHSTDTC; MH.MHENDTC
Derivation: Set LSTALVDT to the latest usable calendar day across DM.RFPENDTC, DM.RFENDTC, DM.DTHDTC, DS.DSSTDTC, EX.EXSTDTC, EX.EXENDTC, AE.AESTDTC, AE.AEENDTC, VS.VSDTC, LB.LBDTC, SV.SVSTDTC, SV.SVENDTC, CM.CMSTDTC, CM.CMENDTC, MH.MHSTDTC, and MH.MHENDTC. A value is usable when it is a complete calendar day, or a complete calendar day followed by the letter T and a clock time. For a value with a clock time, keep only the calendar day. Ignore blanks and partial values that do not match those two patterns. Leave LSTALVDT missing when the subject has no usable day.

Label: Baseline Height (cm)
Derivation: Consider VS rows with VS.VSTESTCD equal to HEIGHT and VS.VSSTRESN not missing. Keep a row only when VS.VSDTC is a usable calendar day on or before ADSL.TRTSDT. Choose the latest VS.VSDTC and break a tie with the greatest VS.VSSEQ. HEIGHTBL is the VS.VSSTRESN from that row, in centimetres. Leave HEIGHTBL missing when ADSL.TRTSDT is missing or no row qualifies.

Label: Baseline Weight (kg)
Derivation: Consider VS rows with VS.VSTESTCD equal to WEIGHT and VS.VSSTRESN not missing. Keep a row only when VS.VSDTC is a usable calendar day on or before ADSL.TRTSDT. Choose the latest VS.VSDTC and break a tie with the greatest VS.VSSEQ. WEIGHTBL is the VS.VSSTRESN from that row, in kilograms. Leave WEIGHTBL missing when ADSL.TRTSDT is missing or no row qualifies.

Label: Baseline BMI (kg/m2)
Derivation: When ADSL.WEIGHTBL and ADSL.HEIGHTBL are both non-missing and ADSL.HEIGHTBL is greater than zero, set BMIBL to ADSL.WEIGHTBL divided by the square of (ADSL.HEIGHTBL divided by 100). Do not round. Otherwise leave BMIBL missing. The unit is kilograms per metre squared.
